title: Review of the CGLE gain big-box negative on fresh seed 5: at eps 1.43 worms grow, writhe and break but labkit finds 0 persistent splits (merge/split 1.2); at eps 1.40 the pulses fade and merge (0 persistent splits, merge/split 1.4)
summary: The finding's world.py with WORLD_P L=80, 192^2, seed 5, t=1000. eps 1.43 (pack_eps1.43/seed5/sheet.png): after a transient network, a mixed population of round ring pulses with dark cores (several persist from t~300 to 1000) and worms that grow, writhe and fragment (t=220-1000); 13 splits, 0 persistent, 16 merges, 0 nucleations; components 8-15. eps 1.40: 9-19 small pulses in depletion halos, 10 splits, 0 persistent, 14 merges, no nucleation; the few that move go at most 2.9 sqrt(area) lengths. Both points reproduce the finding: depletion of the gain turns static pulses into growing, breaking worms, but no daughter persists for the 100 t lineage window.

observations.D: pack_eps1.43/seed5: persistent splits 0 of 13 splits, merges 16; pack_eps1.40/seed5: persistent splits 0 of 10, merges 14

seeds_run.result: pass at eps 1.40 and 1.43: no persistent daughters

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, two of the four eps points, labkit's default 100 t window only. The dark-core ring pulses at eps 1.43 persist for most of the run on this seed (not only at eps 1.42); I did not track them.
